scope: No new model execution, scoring, selection or primary rule changes. Gradient magnitude and clipping incidence do not identify gradient direction quality, causality of forgetting, or effective AdamW update magnitude. No claim all clipping settings equivalent. Raw/generated target length and contents jointly differ.
numerical_limit: Logged norms are the preclip return value. The epsilon proxy uses recorded scalar norms; no near-boundary floating-point equivalence claim. A maximum safely below 1 excludes activation for that recorded run.
